items.title: Jones Hank — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History
items.q: Teddy Reid was also very good at that. Teddy Reid was an A&R man for, I think it was Riverside.

ctx.x: Of the recording companies that you worked for, which one…, Which did you feel provided the best artistic possibility for you or a situation you are performing in?

I will say that Ozzy Cadena was the one who was…I think… You work tomorrow closely with him. He seemed to have a greater affinity for the music. Although, he himself was not a musician, he seems to know what he wanted. Teddy Reid was also very good at that. Teddy Reid was an A&R man for, I think it was Riverside.
